name: Painted Desert Fur Con
blurb: Arizona's furry convention, held New Year's weekend in downtown Phoenix with panels, dances and an artist alley.

editions.evidence: Official Bluesky account bio (bsky.app/profile/painteddesertfc.com, linked from painteddesertfc.org): '📅 January 1-3, 2027 📍 Sheraton Phoenix Downtown, Phoenix, AZ'. Aggregators FurryCons.com and 10times.com independently list the same dates and venue.

notes: painteddesertfc.org is behind a Cloudflare JS challenge ('Just a moment...') that blocked every automated render attempt (default Chromium, --channel msedge, and a Wayback Machine snapshot all came back 403). Used the convention's own official Bluesky account for the confirmed dates/venue and cover image instead. The guest list could not be checked since the site itself could not be loaded, so guests is 'unavailable' rather than 'announced' or 'none-yet'.
